_comment: Safebox config for Autohost. Installed to /etc/safebox/autohost.json. Maps Safebox conventions (paths, socket, IP discovery) onto Autohost's config surface. See MIGRATION-autovhost-to-autohost.md for the full mapping and rationale.
_authorizeHook_comment: Set to /etc/safebox/autohost-authorize-hook.js to enforce Safebox project/quota/token governance on provisioning. Left null for 1.0 (DNS-check + rate limit only); this is the seam for the projects/domains/quota control plane.
